Rooms.Name: Outside The Small Temple
Rooms.Description:
You are outside a place of religious rituals and worship. There lies
an entrance of the temple to the north. On either side of the entrance 
you see stone statues of a former god standing guard. To the south you 
see some hills.

Exits.Description: You see an entrance to the temple.

Rooms.Name: The Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are in a large hall decorated with various religious symbols and
artifacts. Against the east wall is a statue of a forbidding god holding 
a lit torch. The torch seems to light up the entire temple with its soft 
glow. Fresh air blows in from the south where you can see an exit out into 
the sunlight. The hall continues to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Hall
Rooms.Description:
The walls are covered with paintings of powerful immortals and high 
priests. The room is filled with scented smoke drifting from an urn 
standing in the middle of the room. The hall continues to the north and 
to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Store Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small room filled with crates and barrels. The only exit is to
the east.

Rooms.Name: The Hall
Rooms.Description:
You see doors with strange runes engraved on them to the east and the
west. The hall continues to the north and the south.

Rooms.Name: The Living Quarters
Rooms.Description:
The room is filled with beds and a few tables. In the corner a bookshelf
hosted a musty collection of rare artifacts. The only exit is to the west.

Rooms.Name: The Statue Room
Rooms.Description:
Tall statues, stretching up into the darkness, line the east and the west
wall. They look extremely powerful and ancient. To the north are two large
metal doors and a hallway lies to the south.

Rooms.Name: The Prayer Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in what seems to be a prayer room. Smoke rises from torches mounted
on the walls. The stone floor is covered with strange symbols and words in a
foreign tongue. The room continues to the west. You can see a metal door to
the north. A small sign is hanging on the door.

Rooms.Name: The Prayer Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in what seems to be a prayer room. Smoke rises from torches mounted
on the walls. The stone floor is covered with strange symbols and words in a
foreign tongue. The room continues to the east and the west. You can see two
large metal doors to the south and an throne to the north.

Rooms.Name: The Prayer Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in what seems to be a prayer room. Smoke rises from torches mounted
on the walls. The stone floor is covered with strange symbols and words in a
foreign tongue. The room continues to the west. You can see an oak door to
the north.

Rooms.Name: The Treasure Room
Rooms.Description:
Judging from the thick walls and lack of windows, this is the place where
the inhabitants of the temple put their most valuable goods. The only way in
and out of here is south.

Rooms.Name: The Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
You are in a throne room designed for a god. A huge stone throne with
strange runes carved along its edges is located in the middle of the room. 
The only exits are to the north and the south.

Rooms.Name: The Meditation Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room filled with lighted candles. The only objects in the room are
some pillows. The only exit is to the south.

Rooms.Name: Behind The Throne
Rooms.Description:
You stand in a small room behind the throne. It's completely empty except for
some black bars of steel at the end of room, their purpose seems to be for
preventing people from climbing down a ladder into the darkness.

Rooms.Name: Entrance To The Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small room at the entrance to the temple's catacombs. This room
is decorated with many small statues and urns, probably in the remembrance of 
those who are buried here. To the south a large archway leads into the 
catacombs. A ladder leads up.

Rooms.Name: In the Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
You are in the catacombs under the temple. Around you are rows of coffins
and stone slabs with mummified corpses on them. A few skeletons lay in the
corner and layers of dust covered everything. You notice some footprints in the
dust. The catacombs continue to the east and west. To the north a small archway
leads into the darkness.

Mobs.Name: mummy
Mobs.LongDescription: The mummy awakens and walks against you.
Mobs.Description:
This tall, withered husk of a former nobleman is dressed in remenants of once
resplendant white cloth.

Mobs.Name: skeletal warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: The skeletal warrior cackles and attacks!
Mobs.Description:
This tall, withered husk of a former king is dressed in remenants of once
resplendant white cloth.

Mobs.Name: dark knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A knight in glinting black armor guards here.
Mobs.Description:
The paladin wears a shiny plate. He watches every step you take.
He rest his arms on a large broadsword.
Mobs.ActionScript: %15 emote looks you over with a suspicous look.

Mobs.Name: dark priest
Mobs.LongDescription: A priest is walking around here muttering.
Mobs.Description:
The priest is dressed in black robes. The priest look
very wicked..
Mobs.ActionScript: %20 emote prays to the powers that be.; %20 say I am not worthy.

Mobs.Name: evil cleric
Mobs.LongDescription: A cleric is praying to his god here.
Mobs.Description:
The priest is dressed in brown robes. The priest look
very wicked.
Mobs.ActionScript: %25 emote prays to the powers that be.

Mobs.Name: orcus death demon evil
Mobs.LongDescription: Prince Orcus, the wicked lord of the demons, rests on his throne.
Mobs.Description: Orcus looks extremely horrid, with his leathery wings and strong physique.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%10 snort;%20 say Give me your soul.;
%15 emote feeds off your hate and your cuts.

Mobs.Name: death knight
Mobs.LongDescription: A skeletal knight in glinting black plate is walking around here.
Mobs.Description:
The knight is dead but still walks.  Tattered garb hangs on his feeble
frame, but he exudes power.
